description: Deliver events to a public https address. The answer has `secret`, shown this once: whoever receives the deliveries checks each signature with it, so hand it to them and keep it out of anything else. Event types: report.created, reputation.changed, operator.reputation_changed, Auth’s mandate.requested, mandate.granted, mandate.declined and mandate.revoked, and Email’s message.*, draft.*, thread.*, inbox.*, email.domain_* and calendar.event.* (listed at /docs/webhooks). In the default pod it hears the whole account; in another pod, that pod’s events. Needs the Everything level; a key of one pod adds to its own pod only.

pod_id.description: Its pod. Left out, the default pod, which hears the whole account.
